definitions.explanation: A traditional saying that expresses wisdom or advice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧{諺|ことわざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many interesting proverbs in Japan.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{七転|ななころ}び{八起|やお}き→七転び八起き：06141_nanakorobiyaoki⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{諺|ことわざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a proverb that goes 'Fall seven times, stand up eight.'

examples.japanese: {諺|ことわざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ように、「⟦{継続|けいぞく}→継続：00213_keizoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧なり」⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: As the proverb says, 'Perseverance is power.'

examples.english: Proverbs are filled with the wisdom of our ancestors. Many of them are still applicable today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{諺|ことわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦みると→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あっても→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{共通|きょうつう}する→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づく→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: When you look into foreign proverbs, you realize that despite differences in culture and history, there are many commonalities in how people think.

notes:
{諺|ことわざ} refers to proverbs and traditional sayings.
